messages:
sam: noticing elevated nvme_read_retries on us-east1-b rack c3 around 03:07 UTC. GPU attaches delayed.
neha: which instance types?
sam: p4d and a handful of g4. seems tied to janitor runs overlapping heavy kvcache flushes.
kai: pulled dmesg from node c3-112:
[  67.890123] nvme0: retrying R/W command, status: 0x2
[  68.001234] nvme0n1: I/O error, dev nvme0n1
ops-bot: auto-alert: gpu-attach-backoff enacted for us-east1-b (2m)
neha: plan: throttle janitor concurrency to 1 on that rack and do soft nvme reset on the 2 worst hosts, staggered 90s apart. avoid reimages unless SMART crosses threshold.
sam: running soft resets now on c3-112 -> attach success improved. will monitor 20m.
kai: logging INF-4839 to track SMART trends and procurement thresholds.
ops-bot: maintenance scheduled: soft resets queued at 03:11 and 03:12 UTC.
neha: thanks — keeping on watch.
